content: The workspace is empty. Let me find the Grepo repository on GitHub and clone it.

arguments.command: gh repo search Grepo --limit 10 2>/dev/null || curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=Grepo&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5" | python3 -c "import sys,json; repos=json.load(sys.stdin)['items']; [print(r['full_name'], '-', r['description']) for r in repos]"
